description: Introduced the Settings page, early NSFW filtering, video player metadata, and improved mobile support across the experience.

logs.desc: New icons for the landing page's What We Offer section.
Title and uploader metadata for the video player.
A hard-coded NSFW thumbnail filter for selected videos.
Fullscreen mode for the video player.
Visual feedback for controls in the custom video player.
Improved mobile support across the interface.
Font Awesome 7.0 Free icons to Google Material Icons.
Several video player element IDs for better consistency.
Repeated UI patterns into reusable components.
The landing page and its components for a more user-friendly experience.
The video folder structure so video roots are passed through a JSON file in '/public'.
The home page experience into the Featured section.
Videos from the landing page's What We Offer section.
Automatic collapsing on the Update Log / What's New page is currently broken.
